Out of the blue the guy Prathamesh made a call and got the instant approval. I also told him to update in his records that my father cannot sign and to use his thumb impression instead of his signature going forward. He was like we can't update such things in our records and in future also you will have to wait till we get the approval and your father will have to visit no matter what. I learned there is no humanity and empathy left and these guys doesn't care although he can see my father is using stick to walk and he cannot move his right hand. No surprise if they will call the person who is in death bed as a proof of evidence to satisfy their ego. For sure I will surrender my father's other policy once it's lock-in period is over.
Ridiculous and shameless people.
